plain_text:
William Conrad appears in 792 recordings across 35 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1961. The credits here include performer, narrator, announcer, author, director, and writer.

In this archive, you will hear William Conrad most often in Gunsmoke, Escape, The Whistler, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Lux Radio Theatre, CBS Radio Workshop, This Is Your FBI, and Voyage of the Scarlet Queen.

Characters credited here include Matt Dillon, The Clock, and Philip Marlowe.
